name: TSMC Arizona fabs
what: Makes the most advanced logic chips, including AI accelerators, in the US.
closes_gap: Advanced logic chips made only in Taiwan.
status_detail: Fab 1 (4nm) has been in high-volume production since late 2024; Fab 2 construction is finished and tool installation starts in Q3 2026 for 3nm output around 2027 (per Nikkei via a secondary source). Dates and investment totals differ across sources.

sources.title: North Phoenix scores big as TSMC's second chip plant hits finish line
TSMC Arizona (Wikipedia)

name: Intel Ohio fab
what: Planned leading-edge chip factory to make Intel's own processors and contract chips.
closes_gap: Advanced logic chip capacity outside Taiwan and Asia.
status_detail: Intel's February 2025 memo, reported March 3, 2025, moved Fab 1 production to 2030 (from late 2026) and Fab 2 to 2031; construction continues at a slower pace. Hoodline's 2026 coverage repeats the 2030 date but cites the 2025 memo, so no newer date is confirmed.

sources.title: Intel delays new Albany, Ohio chip manufacturing project again to 2030-2031
Intel's new Albany chip factory delayed to 2030 in slow burn buildout

name: Samsung Taylor fab
what: Advanced chip factory that will make chips for AI and other customers.
closes_gap: Advanced logic chips made only in Taiwan and South Korea.
status_detail: Samsung said on its Q2 2026 call (July 2026) that Fab 1 is on track to begin operations in 2026 or early 2027; Fab 2 construction starts by end of 2026 with mass production targeted around 2030.

sources.title: Samsung to begin construction of 2nd chip fab in Texas at end of 2026
Samsung targets late 2026 launch for advanced Texas chip fab following delays: report

name: Micron Boise memory fab
what: Memory chip factory making DRAM, the fast memory used alongside AI chips.
closes_gap: Advanced memory (DRAM/HBM) made mostly in Asia.
status_detail: Micron's FY2026 10-K puts first DRAM wafer output at mid-2027 for Idaho fab 1 and late 2028 for fab 2. Equipment move-in begins later in 2026.

sources.title: Micron Technology Form 10-K, FY2026
Micron posts record year as Boise fab nears production

name: Micron New York megafab
what: Planned large memory chip complex making DRAM for the US market.
closes_gap: Advanced memory (DRAM) made mostly in Asia.
status_detail: Groundbreaking was set for January 16, 2026, for a complex of up to four fab modules (about $100 billion total); the first phase (about $20 billion) was targeted for completion around 2030.

sources.title: Micron groundbreaking date announcement

name: SK hynix HBM packaging plant
what: Plant that stacks memory chips into HBM modules used in AI accelerators.
closes_gap: Advanced packaging of AI memory, done almost entirely in Asia.
status_detail: Groundbreaking held August 27, 2026, at Purdue Research Park; cleanroom targeted for October 2028 and mass production in 2028 or 2029 (sources conflict).

sources.title: SK hynix partners with Purdue University, ceremonially breaks ground on $4B memory chip facility
SK Hynix breaks ground on $4 billion packaging facility in Indiana

name: Amkor advanced packaging campus
what: Packaging campus that connects and protects finished chips, including ones for TSMC Arizona.
closes_gap: Advanced chip packaging, which is done mostly in Asia.
status_detail: Amkor added 67 acres in May 2026 and announced a phase 2 with about $12 billion in investment in September 2026. One trade report gives phase 1 completion in mid-2027 and production in early 2028; treat dates as unconfirmed.

sources.title: Amkor acquires additional land in Arizona to expand advanced packaging campus
Amkor Technology expands U.S. advanced packaging footprint with additional land in Arizona

name: MP Materials Mountain Pass
what: The main US rare earth mine and processing site, producing neodymium-praseodymium oxide for magnets.
closes_gap: Rare earth separation and magnet materials that China dominates.
status_detail: On July 10, 2025, the Pentagon bought $400 million of convertible preferred stock (about 15% stake), agreed a 10-year price floor of $110/kg for NdPr, and provided a $150 million loan for heavy rare earth separation at Mountain Pass.

sources.title: MP Materials lands $400M Pentagon deal
MP Materials lands multibillion-dollar Pentagon deal to bolster US rare earth magnet supply

name: MP Materials Fort Worth magnet plant
what: Plant that turns rare earth metal into permanent magnets, with Apple as a customer.
closes_gap: Rare earth magnets, which China makes most of.
status_detail: Independence facility has begun producing NdPr metal and magnets are made there, with ramp-up through 2026; Apple committed $500 million in November 2025, with recycled-magnet deliveries slated for 2027. Current output figures were not confirmed.

sources.title: Apple, MP Materials announce $500 million deal to expand US rare-earth supply chain
MP Materials hits new high as it receives $150M Pentagon loan

name: Atalco Gramercy gallium circuit
what: Alumina refinery adding a gallium extraction circuit, the first large-scale US primary gallium plan.
closes_gap: Gallium, where China supplies roughly 98 to 99% of low-purity gallium.
status_detail: January 2026 partnership with the US government and private investors; about $450 million total, with roughly $150 million from the Pentagon, targeting up to 50 tonnes per year. No completion date confirmed.

sources.title: Washington commits $450M to revive Atalco, build gallium capacity
Atlantic Alumina secures $800 million with U.S. government and Pinnacle as gallium production targets 50 metric tons annually

name: Novonix Riverside graphite plant
what: Plant making synthetic graphite anode material for lithium-ion batteries.
closes_gap: Battery anode graphite, where China dominates processing.
status_detail: Mass production for Panasonic is still expected in 2H 2027, but full capacity at Riverside was pushed to September 2031 and the second-site land purchase was dropped. A $103 million Section 48C tax credit was certified in April 2026.
